LLMs and Robotics
2
Inside a VLA model
  • State tokens: internal state and sensor data (e.g. LIDAR)
  • Action tokens: generated autoregressively, each one a low-level control signal such as a joint angle update or torque
  • Memory carries context across a long task, such as drying the counter with a sponge
LLMs and Robotics
3
VLMs versus VLAs
  • VLM (GPT-4o, Gemini, SayCan): image plus text in, text, plans or code out; needs downstream controllers
  • VLA (OpenVLA, Octo, π0): camera frames plus text in, continuous 7-DoF deltas out (x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw, gripper)
  • One network unifies perception, instruction understanding and control
LLMs and Robotics
4
Safety of VLA models
  • Visual input and language go straight to motor commands
  • Open-world use needs robust behavioral safety guards
  • Current VLAs lack them: adversarial images, jailbreaks and unsafe commands
  • Discuss: what are the safety implications?
LLMs and Robotics
5
The era of robot-use agents
General-purpose models that control different robots, write policies and learn new physical tasks with little robot-specific training.
Philip Isola, MIT
Bitter Lesson (Sutton): leverage data and the LLM ability to write code and transfer it across domains.
LLMs and Robotics
6
LLM puppeteering from the cloud
  • A shift from bespoke hardware to LLM agents with hardware in the loop
  • Intelligence runs in the cloud and is not tuned to one robot
  • A non-intelligent device could become AI-enabled with a software update
  • Caution: puppeteering may be less reliable than proven robotic systems in safety-critical use

Claude plays robotics: 11 locomotion tasks
Task
What it tests
find_x
Walk to a table marked with a blue X, 25 ft away
visual_search
Find a red sphere hidden behind occluders in a 12 × 12 m arena
color_sequence
Visit colored circles in order; working memory
return_home
Follow waypoints, then return to origin from memory
procedural_maze
Navigate a maze with the forward camera only
invisible_walls
Replan around walls that cannot be seen
obstacle_course
Pass gaps; know the robot’s dimensions
oneshot_course
Plan the whole command sequence from a top-down map
drift_detection
Notice silently corrupted commands and compensate
turn_correction
See that a turn was incomplete and correct it
explore_report
Explore, then answer layout questions from memory

World models and spatial reasoning
  • Discuss: will LLMs struggle with spatial reasoning?
  • Fei-Fei Li: a fully consistent 3D world is required for navigation
  • LeCun: robots need AI that anticipates the consequences of actions
  • Text-only intelligence lacks the physical grounding; a world model lets an agent test plans safely in simulation
